title: Two years old, and a visitor
body: Radha can walk quite well now. When a visitor the child has never met comes to the house, what does the child do first? What you pick leans the child's temperament that way; moment

title: A pause · age 5
body: In India, 2.6% of children never reach their fifth birthday. This child did.

title: A wallet in the street
body: You found a wallet in the street. There is quite a lot of money in it.

title: Finding something you love
body: What will you do with your free time?

title: Go on to middle school?
body: You finished primary school. Going on means paying for school fees, a uniform and transport.

title: Become friends?
body: Manoj, the new kid, sits alone every break. When your eyes meet, they smile awkwardly.

title: Go on to high school?
body: You finished middle school. Some of your friends started working.

title: Talk of an early marriage
body: You are 14, and your parents would like to see you married soon. Talk of a dowry is going back and forth with the other family.

title: A pause · age 15
body: This child is already married. Expected years of schooling: 13 years in India. In this country, 23% of women marry before they turn 18.

title: Take in a pet?
body: At the shelter you saw animals waiting for a family.

title: Buy a lottery ticket?
body: Lottery tickets are sold next to the till. People say this week's jackpot has grown huge.
